entities.title: On a pull request
entities.summary: Rally is typechecked, tested and built, and every .dev diagram is validated.
entities.trigger: A pull request that changes games/rally, or anything under .github/ (ci.yml).
checks: npm test: tsc --noEmit, then the node:test suites in test/
No .dev folders in dist/: the build must not ship the folders' documentation
python3 Meta/Agents/Skills/validate_diagrams.py, for the whole repository
The Database migration check, when worker/schema.sql or worker/migrations/ change
notChecked: The knowledge files: Meta/Agents/Knowledge/validate_knowledge.py is not run in CI.
The games hub's relay and sign-in routes.

entities.title: On a push to main
entities.summary: The same steps again, then wrangler deploy.
entities.trigger: A push to main that changes games/rally or .github/, or Run workflow on the Deploy workflow.
checks: The migration gate: every database change since the last deploy has been acknowledged
No .dev folders in dist/: the build must not ship the folders' documentation
